turn_history.text: Imagine you have two boxes, one with an odd number of marbles and the other with an even number. When you combine them, the total number of marbles will be even, just like when you add two odd numbers together. Can you see how this connects to the equation you wrote out?

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: Um, I think I see what you mean about combining them... but I'm still confused about the equation bit. Like, when I wrote 2n+(2m+1), I thought that was showing two odd numbers, but now I'm not sure if 2n is actually odd or even? Is 2n the even one?

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Imagine you are reading numbers on a number line. Each dash represents a different number, just like each marble in the box represents a different number of marbles. When you see 2n, think about what that means in terms of the numbers on the number line. Can you see how 2n represents an even number in this context?
